## Public-release safety checklist

- [ ] No `.env` file or secret-bearing configuration
- [ ] No AWS credential, SSH private key, API key, session token, password, or database URL
- [ ] No private infrastructure identifier or internal incident evidence
- [ ] No customer or personal data
- [ ] No wholesale copy of private operational backend source
- [ ] Any screenshot or video has been visually checked for sensitive information
- [ ] Simulator-only positioning remains clear
- [ ] This change does not imply real deposits, withdrawals, custody, or real-money trading are live
